name.en-US: Sermon at Paul's at the Abjuration of Barnes
name.pt-BR: Sermão em São Paulo na Abjuração de Barnes

description.en-US: Fisher's sermon at St Paul's Cross, 11 February 1526, at the abjuration of the Augustinian Robert Barnes.
description.pt-BR: O sermão de Fisher em São Paulo, a 11 de fevereiro de 1526, na abjuração do agostiniano Robert Barnes.

sources.edition: A sermon had at Paulis by the commaundement of ... Cardinal Wolsey, EEBO-TCP A00769.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 56 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. John Fisher died in 1535; the edition is of 1526 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
